name: Puppeteer (archived reference server)
upstream_status_note: The repository is archived (read-only) on GitHub. The npm record marks the package deprecated. Quoted: “Archived and unmaintained; no security guarantees. See https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived”. The repository's own README says it is no longer maintained. Quoted: “This repository is archived and no longer maintained.”.
outcome_statement: As of 2026-11-14: meets C4, C6; partly meets C1, C2, C7, C8, C9, C10; does not meet C3, C5.

findings.title: Source and release provenance
findings.finding: The npm record for @modelcontextprotocol/server-puppeteer@2025.5.12 has no repository field; its deprecation notice names the archive repository. The record carries no provenance attestation. Quoted: “Archived and unmaintained; no security guarantees. See https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived”.

findings.title: Published security policy
findings.finding: GitHub shows a security policy for the repository (`SECURITY.md`); the policy says the repository is no longer covered by a vulnerability disclosure programme. Quoted: “This archived repository is no longer covered by our vulnerability disclosure program.”.

findings.title: Maintenance status
findings.finding: The repository is archived (read-only) on GitHub. The npm record marks the package deprecated. Quoted: “Archived and unmaintained; no security guarantees. See https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers-archived”. The repository's own README says it is no longer maintained. Quoted: “This repository is archived and no longer maintained.”. Latest release 2025.5.12 is dated 2025-05-12; the newest commit on `main` is dated 2025-05-28; GitHub reports the last push on 2025-05-28.

findings.title: Published advisories
findings.finding: No advisory is published in the repository's advisory list for @modelcontextprotocol/server-puppeteer.

findings.title: Documented scope controls
findings.finding: The README describes browser automation including JavaScript execution; the only documented restriction concerns browser launch options, and no option to restrict navigation or script execution was found. Searched `src/puppeteer/README.md` for: read-only, allowlist, restrict, blocked. Quoted: “This server enables LLMs to interact with web pages, take screenshots, and execute JavaScript in a real browser environment.”.

findings.title: Credential handling in the documented setup
findings.finding: The documented setup takes no credential. Searched `src/puppeteer/README.md` for: API_KEY, _TOKEN\b, password.

findings.title: Telemetry and outbound data, as documented
findings.finding: The documented function is driving a browser to arbitrary pages. The README contains no reference to telemetry. Searched `src/puppeteer/README.md` for: telemetry, usage statistics, usage stats, we collect, data collection, opt-out, posthog. Quoted: “This server enables LLMs to interact with web pages”.

findings.title: Dependency management files
findings.finding: A lockfile (`package-lock.json`) is committed. No Dependabot or Renovate configuration file exists at the paths listed in the methodology.

findings.title: Documentation of untrusted-content risk
findings.finding: The README carries a caution about what the server can reach; it does not name prompt injection or untrusted content. Quoted: “This server can access local files and local/internal IP addresses since it runs a browser on your machine.”.

findings.title: Currency of the declared MCP library
findings.finding: Declared MCP library: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.0.1. Lower-bound version 1.0.1 of @modelcontextprotocol/sdk (npm) was published on 2024-11-26, between 12 and 24 months before 2026-11-14.
